reason: The plugin is primarily a notification utility for DSH Web that gives users an audible cue when an assistant finishes responding, with runtime behavior implemented in the browser using session-state tracking and a generated chime sound, and no evidence of non-notification or external service functionality.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于在 DSH Web 中在助手回答结束时播放提示音，帮助用户在会话完成时快速察觉状态变化。
summaries.en: This plugin plays a chime in DSH Web when an assistant finishes replying, helping users notice when a response has completed.

capabilities: plays a browser-generated notification sound when an assistant reply completes
monitors session running-state transitions in the DSH Web client
provides configurable toggles and volume control

reasons.code: README states this is a DSH Web plugin that plays a ding sound when assistant reply ends, and explains detection by watching session running state from true to false.
Package metadata declares a web client plugin via dsh.client and injects dsh-client-runtime, indicating browser-side execution only.
Repository includes lib/client.js and cordis.patch.yml for client integration, with lib/index.js as a server-side placeholder for loader wiring.
